creative_premise: The room does not merely display successive lines; each entry is a deterministic score that coordinates language, spatial drift, threshold state, and opt-in sound parameters without using randomness, wall-clock state, network input, or persistent identity.
verified_properties: Visit zero is a stable pre-entry listening state.
Equal visit counts generate byte-equivalent JSON scores.
Every fourth entry changes the authored threshold language.
Narrative text cycles while spatial state continues to evolve.
Visual radius growth is bounded after twelve entries.
independence_boundaries: No Mirror Cartographer imports or vocabulary dependencies.
No analytics, authentication, payments, product funnel, or external service.
No random source or wall-clock input.
No localStorage, cookies, account identifier, or durable personal identity.
Audio remains parameter-only until invoked by the existing explicit user gesture path.
claim_limits: The score engine is committed and unit-tested but is not yet wired into index.html.
No browser execution, physical-device audibility, deployment, or public-preview claim is made.
The repository dependency installation state was not changed.

rollback.method: Revert the two additive commits in reverse order.

next_action: Wire scoreVisit into the existing Fourth Room interaction and drawing/audio paths, then run both Node and Playwright suites before any isolated preview.
